An App Clip is a lightweight version of your app that offers some of its functionality when and where people need it or that people use to try out your full app.
App Clips require a corresponding full app that offers at least the same functionality as the App Clip; you use the same Xcode project for your full app and your App Clip.
App Clips make use of the same frameworks as full apps, and adding code or assets to an App Clip target works just like it does for any other target.
